tasks.commitBody:
Season management now lives in one card: a new outer bordered
container holds the admin header row ([+ Season], the visible
'Manage season' label, and the gear) with the season-manage panel
expanding below the header inside the same frame — no second stacked
border. The gear keeps its #213 toggle semantics untouched
(aria-expanded, aria-controls, close-refusal while a bulk run is
unfinished, focus return on close).

The role=toolbar element stays scoped to the header row only, with
the panel as its sibling inside the card — nesting the dialog into
the toolbar would have silently pulled every panel button into the
arrow-key roving pool (handleAdminToolbarKeydown queries the full
subtree) and violated ARIA toolbar semantics; new panel-open tests
pin both. The collapsed label reuses season_manage_gear_label (no
new keys, all four locales), renders only under the same rights gate
as the gear, and provides the gear's accessible name via
aria-labelledby so the string is authored once.

Eng calls per the issue: role=toolbar + roving tabindex survive at
arity 2 (label is static text, not a stop); season-create-form
placement is left where it was (pre-existing separation, out of
scope — flag if it should move into the card).

Live gate (Mihkel, phone per §8.2): collapsed card shows 'Manage
season' next to the gear; gear opens the panel inside the same
frame and closes it again; check the header row wrap on a phone in
lv/uk (longest labels).
